no_ttl_practical_robustness.title: No-TTL Practical Robustness
no_ttl_practical_robustness.evidence: Stacking and RF changes fell below practical materiality thresholds (|delta_Backdoor| < 6, |delta_Macro-F1| < 0.01).

rf_practical_stability.title: RF Practical Stability
rf_practical_stability.evidence: RF Backdoor detection and Macro-F1 showed zero observed change under Seed 42, remaining below practical materiality thresholds.

stacking_practical_stability.title: Stacking Practical Stability
stacking_practical_stability.evidence: Stacking showed delta Backdoor = -2 (< 6) and delta Macro-F1 = -0.0017 (< 0.01).

svm_greater_representation_sensitivity.title: SVM Representation Sensitivity
svm_greater_representation_sensitivity.evidence: Linear SVM exhibited material drops (delta Backdoor = -11 >= 6, delta Macro-F1 = -0.0184 >= 0.01).

ae_primary_threshold_unseen_family_detec.title: AE Primary-Threshold Detection
ae_primary_threshold_unseen_family_detec.evidence: 0 detections observed across all 4 AE-unseen attack families under primary threshold mean+3sigma.

threshold_tradeoff.title: Threshold Trade-Off
threshold_tradeoff.evidence: Several relaxed threshold operating points increased observed detections for selected AE-unseen attack families, accompanied in the corresponding evaluated settings by higher benign false-positive rates.

three_seed_characterization.title: Three-Seed Characterization
three_seed_characterization.evidence: The three evaluated seeds (42, 123, 2024) are summarized descriptively. Observed seed-to-seed variation is reported using mean, SD, minimum, maximum, and range. No formal preregistered criterion for seed “consistency” was defined; therefore the analysis does not establish formal seed robustness.

canonical_ae_vs_new_ae_equivalence.title: Canonical AE vs New AE Equivalence
canonical_ae_vs_new_ae_equivalence.evidence: Computed contingency table A=0, B=0, C=0, D=583 (discordant pairs=0).

claims.claim: No-TTL removal materially harms ensemble performance.
claims.allowed_wording: Observed differences in Stacking Backdoor detection and Macro-F1 fell below the predeclared practical materiality thresholds under the evaluated ablation.
claims.forbidden_wording: No-TTL removal materially degrades the stacking ensemble.

claims.claim: No-TTL removal has little effect on RF.
claims.statistical_support: Computed A=582, B=0, C=0, D=1; status=STRUCTURALLY_NON_INFORMATIVE.
claims.allowed_wording: RF Backdoor detection and Macro-F1 showed no observed change under Seed 42, remaining below practical materiality thresholds.
claims.forbidden_wording: RF is statistically proven to be unaffected by TTL features.

claims.claim: SVM is more sensitive to TTL-related representation changes.
claims.allowed_wording: The linear SVM exhibited greater sensitivity to the evaluated No-TTL representation change than the ensemble models.
claims.forbidden_wording: TTL features causally determine SVM performance.

claims.claim: AE robustly detects unseen attack families.
claims.source_result: AE primary threshold (mean+3sigma) yielded 0 detections across all 4 evaluated families and all 3 seeds.
claims.effect_size: Detection rate = 0.0% across all evaluated families.
claims.allowed_wording: No detections were observed for the evaluated AE-unseen families under the conservative primary mean+3sigma threshold.
claims.forbidden_wording: AE robustly defends against unseen zero-day attacks.

claims.claim: Relaxed thresholds recover some anomaly signal.
claims.source_result: Under p95, AE detected 35/583 Backdoor, 6/44 Worms, 9/378 Shellcode, 27/677 Analysis (Seed 42).
claims.statistical_support: Confirmed in complete 60-cell secondary threshold matrix.
claims.allowed_wording: Relaxed threshold rules revealed limited family-dependent anomaly signal across selected operating points.
claims.forbidden_wording: Relaxed thresholds completely solve zero-day detection.

claims.claim: Relaxed thresholds improve detection at an FPR cost.
claims.source_result: At p95, benign dev-test FPR increased from ~0.035% to 5.62% (Seed 42) and 8.60% (Seed 123).
claims.statistical_support: Confirmed across evaluated cells of the benign FPR matrix.
claims.effect_size: FPR increases up to 8.60% (3,182 false alarms per 37,000 flows).
claims.allowed_wording: Several relaxed threshold operating points increased observed detections for selected AE-unseen attack families, accompanied in the corresponding evaluated settings by higher benign false-positive rates.
claims.forbidden_wording: Relaxing the threshold always increases detection at the cost of FPR across all settings.

claims.allowed_wording: 0 detections were observed in the evaluated samples under the primary threshold.

claims.claim: The canonical and No-TTL AEs are equivalent.
claims.source_result: Computed paired contingency: A=0, B=0, C=0, D=583.
claims.allowed_wording: No discordant detections were observed in the paired comparison; this does not establish equivalence.
claims.forbidden_wording: Canonical and No-TTL AEs are equivalent.

claims.source_result: Empirical threshold values (~10.56 to 11.59) are strongly influenced by long-tailed benign validation errors.
claims.statistical_support: Sample mean and variance are inherently sensitive to distribution tail.
claims.effect_size: High threshold driven by benign reconstruction variance.
claims.allowed_wording: The conservative mean+3sigma threshold is influenced by the empirical reconstruction-error distribution.

claims.claim: Stage-C frozen report uses 'outlier-resistant mean+3sigma' wording.
claims.allowed_wording: Flagged for future manuscript revision: replace with 'conservative threshold dependent on empirical error distribution'.

claims.claim: Supervised model performance is consistent across seeds.
claims.source_result: Seeds 42, 123, 2024 evaluated for Stage-B supervised models.
claims.statistical_support: Observed variation summarized by mean, SD, min, max, and range. No formal preregistered criterion for consistency was defined.
claims.effect_size: Macro-F1 ranges: DT 0.0017, RF 0.0012, SVM 0.0055, NN 0.0044, Stacking 0.0006.
claims.allowed_wording: The three evaluated seeds (42, 123, 2024) are summarized descriptively. Observed seed-to-seed variation is reported using mean, SD, minimum, maximum, and range. No formal preregistered criterion for seed 'consistency' was defined; therefore the analysis does not establish formal seed robustness.
claims.forbidden_wording: Performance is statistically proven robust, stable, or generalizable across seeds.

claims.claim: Relaxing threshold increases detection at the cost of FPR.
claims.source_result: 60-cell secondary threshold detection matrix and 15-cell benign dev-test FPR matrix.
claims.statistical_support: At p95 (Seed 42), Backdoor det reaches 6.00% (vs 0%), but FPR rises to 5.62% (vs 0.035%).
claims.effect_size: FPR increases up to 8.60% (3,182 false alarms / 37,000 flows).
claims.allowed_wording: Several relaxed threshold operating points increased observed detections for selected AE-unseen attack families, accompanied in the corresponding evaluated settings by higher benign false-positive rates.
claims.forbidden_wording: Relaxing the threshold always increases detection at the cost of FPR across all settings, families, and thresholds.

claims.claim: Random Forest McNemar paired test is structurally non-informative.
claims.source_result: Computed paired contingency table from row-level predictions: A=582, B=0, C=0, D=1 on Backdoor N=583.
claims.statistical_support: Computed discordant pairs B+C = 0. Structural degeneracy confirmed directly from data.
claims.effect_size: Discordant pairs = 0. Raw p = 1.00000, Holm-adjusted p = 1.00000.
claims.allowed_wording: For RF, row-level paired comparison revealed A=582, B=0, C=0, D=1 (B+C=0). The test is structurally non-informative and cannot evaluate difference or establish equivalence.
claims.forbidden_wording: RF has B=0, C=0 inferred merely from equal aggregate detection counts.
